name: findpeaks
expr: [pk,lo] = findpeaks(x,'SortStr','descend'); mph = findpeaks(x,'MinPeakHeight',2); [pd,ld] = findpeaks(x,'MinPeakDistance',3); [pp,lp] = findpeaks(y,'MinPeakProminence',3); [yk,yl,yw,yr] = findpeaks(y); [eh1,eh2,ehw] = findpeaks(y,'WidthReference','halfheight'); [ep1,ep2,epw] = findpeaks(y,'WidthReference','halfprom'); [pe1,pe2,pew] = findpeaks(ped,'WidthReference','halfheight');
comment: Sig [pks,locs,w,p]=findpeaks(Y[,X|Fs],Name,Value). Default = strict local maxima (1-based idx). Options: MinPeakHeight, Threshold, MinPeakDistance, NPeaks, SortStr, MinPeakProminence, WidthReference ('halfprom' default / 'halfheight'). w = width per the chosen reference: halfprom interpolates crossings of h-prom/2 over the prominence interval; halfheight crosses h/2 on each side's non-increasing walk from the peak (stops at the first strict rise; a sample equal to ref lands exactly on it; no crossing => the first floor plateau's leftmost index — the pedestal case pew(1)=6). MinPeakWidth/MaxPeakWidth/Annotate/DoubleSided still deferred. Branches covered: all listed options + both width references + pedestal no-crossing. Matches MATLAB R2025b (width rules probed 2026-09-17).
